node.title: Re^5: Restrict file search within current filessystem using wanted subroutine
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Hi Anonymous,

"All flavours of Unix" is a very broad question that is difficult to answer generally, but FWIW I believe [man://stat;2|stat(2)] is a relatively well-standardized function. What specific flavors of Unix do you want to run your script on which you are concerned about?

Also, have a look at [doc://perlport#stat|perlport], which lists known issues with [doc://stat] across various platforms.

Hope this helps,
-- Hauke D
